name: preview-studio-monorepo
description: Store Preview Studio monorepo: Core standalone studio & React Next.js marketing landing page
author: Kai DevLabs <kai.devlabs@gmail.com>

scripts.build: npm --prefix core run build && npm --prefix core run build:try
scripts.deploy:landing: npm --prefix core run build:try && npm --prefix marketing run build && npx wrangler pages deploy marketing/out --project-name store-preview-studio
scripts.deploy:portfolio: npm --prefix portfolio run build && npx wrangler pages deploy portfolio/out --project-name kaidevlabs
scripts.deploy:cv: npm --prefix cv run build && npx wrangler pages deploy cv/out --project-name kaicv
scripts.push:landing: git subtree push --prefix marketing landing main
